svg.title: Same record picked when the order is swapped
svg.desc: Order consistency across eight models on Sales (59,685 pairs), Contract (5,000 pairs), and Drug Safety (5,000 pairs). Bars show the fraction of pairs where both orders select the same record. Each bar has the exact counts in its title.
